variants.title: A · 简洁聊天型
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: ONE high-fidelity, realistically implementable Chinese iPhone COACH CHAT screen, a visual proposal, not real account data.
Input image 1 is ONLY the approved HOME SCREEN visual-style reference. Create a NEW Coach screen, do not reproduce the Home content. Match the reference's warm off-white #FBF9F6 canvas, deep indigo #14204C typography, apricot #FBC098 accents, soft lavender #EEEFFC and pale blue secondary surfaces, spacious layout, white rounded cards, extremely subtle shadows and consistent outline icons. Brand name must be exactly "称小二" (first character 称), with the small friendly ivory weighing-scale mascot in an apricot rounded-square app mark.
Output: one full-bleed flat portrait iPhone screenshot, about 1024x2176 proportions. No physical phone frame, no collage, no comparison board, no annotations outside the screen, no variant letter on the UI. Native iOS status bar at top and home indicator at bottom. Sharp correctly written simplified-Chinese text, legible realistic mobile type sizes.
Persistent bottom nav MUST match home reference: four evenly spaced outline icons and exact labels "今天", "教练", "趋势", "我的". THIS time 教练 is selected, an indigo rounded-square icon backplate with an apricot chat-bubble detail; 今天 is inactive, other tabs gray. Bottom navigation and composer have separate safe areas, never overlap content.
Use this same illustrative conversation in all proposals so differences are visual, not random content: small time divider "今天 18:50"; user message containing a genuine everyday Chinese dinner PHOTO (rice, chicken with vegetables, and cabbage) and short text "这是我今天的晚餐"; coach response, labeled "医生教练", "有主食，也有蔬菜和蛋白质来源，搭配挺完整。"; second short coach sentence "不用一下子做到完美，慢慢调整就好。"; one small user bubble "好，今天先这样。". A tasteful doctor/medkit outline avatar rather than a photograph of a real clinician. Clearly distinguish user's right-aligned bubbles and doctor's left-aligned responses. No assistant/system chat bubbles, no duplicate record cards, no raw RAG evidence or citations in the doctor's speech.
A single compact transient system notice must sit IMMEDIATELY ABOVE the input area, separate from conversation: small checkmark icon, exact short text "晚餐已记录", a small "10s" countdown indicator and a comfortably tappable X close icon. It is an operational toast, not a chat message or a permanent history card.
Bottom input composer: camera/photo button, multiline pill input with placeholder "吃了什么，或者想聊聊…", send-up-arrow button. Keyboard hidden. Give controls useful 44-point touch areas and leave breathing space. No microphone/voice/call/video buttons, no extra unimplemented appointment or payment controls.
Avoid: the old green theme; pure single-color interface; neon, saturated blue, large gradients, glassmorphism; decorative food floating around; stock fitness models; calorie budgets, weight statistics, rankings, streak gamification, guilt/shame, medical diagnoses; watermarks or Expo gear.

Direction A — CHAT FIRST / QUIET CLARITY. Most directly evolves the existing chat screen with minimal UI and maximum conversation space. Small horizontal brand header (apricot app mark + 称小二 on left, small apricot "教练在线" status pill right), followed by a compact coach identity row with a pale-lavender doctor avatar, "医生教练" in bold indigo and a muted subtitle "帮你记着，也帮你盯着。". Keep this row modest, no large hero.
The user's photo bubble on the right has a deep-indigo surface with white caption, rounded corners, photo cropped in a sensible horizontal-ish thumbnail inside the bubble rather than a full-screen photo. The doctor replies are white rounded bubbles with navy text, small lavender avatars aligned to the left. Gentle irregular bubble widths, clean readable line spacing. One reply can be split into two bubbles for breathing room. Muted timestamps and an intentionally calm visual rhythm. Keep the transient notice a very light apricot slim pill. Composer white, camera on pale lavender, send circular indigo. Make this elegant and product-ready, not a messaging app clone with heavy borders.

Rounded 22-point corners, very subtle curved shapes inspired by the home metric cards, no giant illustrations.
Conversation below the card has right-aligned PALE APRICOT user bubbles with dark brown text, not dark-indigo user bubbles. The user's dinner photo is in one pale-apricot media bubble; doctor replies in large airy WHITE rounded bubbles, tiny muted sender labels, lavender accent avatar. A small pale-blue decorative accent may appear in the coach identity area, keeping the multi-color but restrained home identity.
System toast remains above input, slim lavender/white status surface with orange check, "晚餐已记录", "10s", X.
